published_ranges._drying: 50-65C 4-6h (oven; TDS says a filament dryer is not recommended)
published_ranges._ams: Not stated in TDS; 85A TPU is generally too soft for AMS - feed externally. TDS recommends direct drive with the spool mounted above the extruder.
published_ranges._notes: TDS: short melt zones may need 215-225C, long melt zones 200-210C; black often prints slightly cooler than white. Melting point 200C. Cooling fan on. ISO 10993-5/-10/-23 biocompatibility tested. Diameter not stated on TDS.
